agent_explanation: Emergency preemption at t=66 during NS yellow immediately forces EW green at step 66, skipping the all-red clearance interval. NS was green at step 64, yellow at 65 (only 1s of yellow instead of required 6s), then EW green at 66 with 0s all-red (need 4s). This violates all_red_clearance and also yellow_duration. Removing the emergency restores normal sequencing.
